Name: Yuzu Chest
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#d4d4d8]A huge chest for your QoL.[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#d4d4d8]Nothing complicated!
Just use it like any other chest.[/color][/b][/font][/size]


[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Additional Features [/size][/color][/b][/font]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51306]Custom Backpack Framework for Yuzu Chest[/url][/color][/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b]Adds compatibility fixes for [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29382?tab=files]Pack and Backpack Collection[/url][/i] when using vanilla chests or Yuzu Chest. Compatible with Automate, Chests Anywhere, and Better Sort.
[/b][/font][/size]
[color=#ffd966][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Supports Alternative Textures.[/b][/font][/size][/color]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Download and unzip Yuzu Chest.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
